title: Reconstruction / Redevelopment of Cessed Buildings in Island City (or MCGM-owned old buildings)
scope: Cessed buildings existing prior to 30/9/1969 in Island City (Mumbai City area), attracting the provisions of MHAD Act 1976. Also covers MCGM/Corporation-owned buildings existing prior to 30/9/1969.

eligibility.attracts: Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Act, 1976
eligibility.post_1996_tenancy_note: New tenancy created after 13/6/1996 shall NOT be considered for FSI computation

rehab_tenement_carpet.max_note: Maximum 120 sqm carpet free of cost (updated from 70 sqm). Beyond that, occupier pays cost of construction per ASR to developer.
rehab_tenement_carpet.non_residential_formula: Equal to existing area occupied in old building
rehab_tenement_carpet.excess_carpet_counted_for_rehab_fsi_only: Carpet above 120 sqm counted for rehab FSI but NOT incentive FSI

surplus_bua_to_mbrrb.description: Prescribed % of surplus BUA per Third Schedule of MHAD Act 1976 handed to MBRRB for accommodating occupants of unreconstructable cessed buildings/transit camps
surplus_bua_to_mbrrb.handover_alternative: Area equivalent to market-value BUA (ASR of that year) may be provided elsewhere in same or adjoining ward

fungible_compensatory.on_surplus_bua_to_mhada_or_mcgm: No premium; surplus is EXCLUSIVE of fungible if fungible is availed
fungible_compensatory.restriction: Fungible on surplus-to-MHADA/MCGM CANNOT be used for sale component

non_residential_use_of_incentive_fsi.note: 20% of incentive FSI may be used for non-residential purposes otherwise permissible in DCPR

reservation_overlay.reserved_zone_redev_allowed: Redev in any zone allowed on-site without change-of-zone process (except industrial user existing segregating distance)
reservation_overlay.small_non_buildable_reservation_up_to_50: Cleared by shifting tenants; site absorbed
reservation_overlay.large_reservation_over_500_sqm: Redev of up to 67% of reservation area allowed; 33% surrendered clear to MCGM
reservation_overlay.school_reservation_RE_1_1_or_RE_1_2: Developer builds school (min 500 students) at cost, hands over FoC; that BUA excluded from FSI computation; land then developable at full permissible FSI
reservation_overlay.parking_lot_reservation: 100% BUA @ Zonal FSI of reserved area handed to MCGM
reservation_overlay.other_buildable_reservations: 25% of BUA of reservation area handed to MCGM free of cost

premium.formula: max(25% of normal premium, 6.25% of ASR land rate for FSI 1)

additional_development_cess.formula: max(100% of development charges on BUA over Zonal FSI, ₹5000/sqm)
additional_development_cess.applies_to: BUA over Zonal (basic) FSI, for rehab + free sale components

non_cessed_portion_treatment.up_to_25_pct_of_plot_area: Not deducted; FSI computed on total plot area
non_cessed_portion_treatment.above_25_pct: Portion above 25% deducted from plot area; that deducted area's FSI is per Reg 30

cross_references.reg_32_tdr: Owner may opt for TDR instead of on-plot incentive FSI

extraction_gaps.note: MHAD Third Schedule surplus BUA percentage is not in DCPR text — determined by MHADA table. Numeric FSI-required-for-rehab depends on actual eligible occupant list per MBRRB.
extraction_gaps.calculator_status: PENDING — need at least one reference 33(7) feasibility (ideally a cessed A-category redevelopment) to validate before authoring Reg33_7_Calculator.php
